title: Write a pure slugify function
description: Provide a small Python function that lowercases ASCII text, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and strips leading or trailing hyphens. Do not execute it.
validation_output:
## Code
```python
import re

def slugify(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", value.lower()).strip("-")
```

## Explanation
The function normalizes case, collapses separators with one regular expression, and trims boundary hyphens.

## Validation
I did not execute it. Reviewers should test empty input, repeated punctuation, spaces, and already-normalized text.

title: Write a CSV header checker
description: Provide a self-contained Python function that accepts a list of column names and returns missing required columns without reading files or running external code.
validation_output:
## Code
```python
def missing_columns(columns: list[str], required: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(required.difference(columns))
```

## Explanation
The function performs a set difference and returns stable sorted output without file or network access.

## Validation
I did not execute it. Check complete, partial, duplicate, and empty column lists and confirm the expected missing names.
